authority: User requested completing the full research prototype; ADR-001 permits a documented bounded source/scope revision during P03
scope_rationale: Use the central 0.1-degree square within the original 1-degree study region at full native grid support. The earlier stride-10 access sample does not establish the regional native-grid scientific result. This narrower first benchmark bounds retrieval without pretending skipped native cells represent complete area coverage.

baseline_policy.label: 20-year product-specific seasonal reference; not a 30-year WMO climate normal

measurement: Same source product, foundation-SST CF semantics and units for current and baseline. No fixed-depth value is invented for foundation temperature. Missing or inconsistent metadata blocks compatibility.
qc: Inspect source mask definitions and valid ranges before acceptance. Only finite SST with unambiguous open-sea mask and valid nonnegative source analysis-error values can qualify. L4 analysis-error is not independent uncertainty for an aggregated anomaly.
availability: Preserve retrieval timestamps and byte identities. First observed availability is bounded by actual retrieval; historical 2025 publication/availability cannot be reconstructed from a 2026 retrieval. This is an analysis using data available at execution, not a historical-as-of replay.
rights: Require preserved primary metadata license text and hash confirming use/preservation. Preserve JPL/NASA acknowledgment in evidence. No provider key or private source URL is required.
gate: Probe failure, missing years/days, inconsistent grid/season/units/mask/rights or insufficient support must block G03. No baseline is fabricated and this ADR does not establish a numerical science or independent review PASS.
